memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “Be holy, for I am holy.” - 1 Peter 1:16

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The world wants to live mixing both holiness and jolly pleasures. But when a holy life gets blended with worldly entertainments, its depth, strength, and spiritual benefit begin to fade. Jolly pleasures easily lead a person toward carelessness, compromise, fleshly desires, and worldly attractions.

The rich man who cried out in Hades begging Abraham for just a drop of water was not a terrible sinner. But his entire life was sunk in pleasure, comfort, and careless living. He never took holiness seriously. His comfortable lifestyle blinded his spiritual eyes. Today the same worldly comforts and entertainments are blinding millions in the same way.

But those who seek holiness are different. They hold themselves in discipline. They set clear spiritual boundaries for their life. They do not take even a small distraction lightly. Above all, they desire to walk holding the hand of God. They pray that their path must always stay within the holy fence of God’s Word.

Holy or Jolly?
Whichever you choose will become the deciding factor of your eternity. Choose carefully. Choose wisely.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “A holy life creates deep influence and impact. Lighthouses do not make noise; they simply shine.” - D. L. Moody

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, grant me the grace to choose lasting holiness over temporary pleasures. Help me to understand the eternal truth that the rich man ignored. Keep my steps within the boundaries set by Your Word. Strengthen me daily to walk in holiness.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the Lord keep your heart close to holiness and far from the blindness of worldly pleasures.
May His true Word guide and lead every event and decision in your life.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: “The Purpose Driven Life”
recommended_book.author: Rick Warren
recommended_book.quote: “Knowing your purpose simplifies your life. It defines what you can do and what you should not do. Your purpose becomes the standard for deciding what is essential and what is unnecessary. Ask yourself: ‘Will this action help me fulfill God’s purpose for my life?’”
